reviews.title: Lasted 4 months, then smoked.
reviews.comment: Started out well enough. Fairly quiet. Driving a tower computer with SSD. The only thing in the box that required some juice was a nVidia GTX 1650 Super GPU, about 350W. The CPU was an older Core i7, RAM was DDR4. This supply should have been just fine. The box always ran cool and quiet. The PSU went *pop* while checking email and reading the news. Maybe the news killed it. The news has been bad for everyone these days. Maybe the PSU was protesting something. Who knows. Shining a flashlight into it, I could see a lot of blobby solder joints that looked sketchy, caps were rated at lower voltages, and overall build quality wasn't great. I decided to replace this with a Corsair PSU. More expensive, but WOW! What a difference in build quality. The box has been running great ever since -- for over a year and a half. The news is still bad, but this PSU doesn't seem to mind -- it just keeps chugging along reliably, doing its job, being solid, not making problems. I like that in a PSU.
